mintAuthority.summary: Operational BRLm issuance runs through the Mento Broker, which burns incoming Mento stable tokens and mints the outgoing token during the USDm/BRLm swap. StableTokenV2 also authorizes the Celo ValidatorsProxy, but its current implementation only mints registry USDm for EpochManager; its Celo-Governance-owned proxy is therefore a latent upgrade-controlled BRLm mint surface. exchange() is zero, and the two-day Mento Timelock can change the token's broker, validators, and exchange slots and upgrade the BRLm token and Broker. D14: issuance is economically unbounded because the token owner can set an arbitrary Broker/minter with no token-level collateral check; the two-day delay does not bound the amount. D29 is not certified because the authorized Validators proxy has separate Celo Governance upgrade authority.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Timelock - BRLm token and Broker administrator

controls.label: Mento Broker - operational BRLm swap minter
controls.capDescription: Broker swaps are restricted to registered exchange providers and their exchange validation. For each exchange/token limit ID, configured trading-limit flags activate net-flow state updates and verification; exceeding a configured limit reverts. Limits are governance-configurable rather than an immutable BRLm supply ceiling. Numeric current pool limits have not been decoded in this review.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 72138428, broker() on BRLm returned this Broker. Broker swaps call transferIn to burn the incoming Mento stable and transferOut to mint the outgoing stable only through registered exchanges subject to exchange and trading-limit checks.

controls.label: Mento Timelock - BRLm token and Broker administrator
controls.evidence: At Celo block 72138428, this 172800-second Timelock was the BRLm token and Broker owner and proxy admin. StableTokenV2 ownership can change broker, validators, and exchange authorization slots, while the proxy-admin role can replace token and Broker mint-critical logic.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized BRLm minter slot
controls.evidence: At Celo block 72138428, validators() returned this proxy and StableTokenV2 admitted it in onlyMinter. The current Validators implementation can only mint the Registry StableToken (USDm) to EpochManager and has no generic or BRLm-targeting call, so it is authorized at token level but cannot currently issue BRLm.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators proxy upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At Celo block 72138428, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner() returned this GovernanceProxy and _getImplementation() returned 0x13B0B89F3242f815C1FC6C9CF56e1Ab5aEA4dC58. Governance can change the authorized proxy's implementation, creating a latent BRLm mint path, but does not currently have a direct BRLm call.

review.evidence: At Celo block 72138428, broker() returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD, validators() returned 0xaEb865bCa93DdC8F47b8e29F40C5399cE34d0C58, and exchange() was zero. The Broker is the live swap mint/burn path. The current Validators implementation can only mint registry USDm for EpochManager, but its Celo-Governance-owned proxy remains a latent upgrade-controlled authorization surface. The 172800-second Mento Timelock owns and administers the BRLm token and Broker. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the two-day Mento Timelock governs broker and token minter replacement while Celo governance controls the latent validator upgrade path, the live Mento Reserve feed covers the shared backing, and no independent attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced. D14/D29 review 2026-10-03 at Celo block 79142378 (hash 0xe5ac3917c420c5f097992356e3a8934c336d354a139b8a1207fe547af3569c6c): owner(), _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolve to Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not the migration Safe; the implementation slot resolves to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Read-only setBroker(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) from that owner succeeds, and mint(chosenRecipient,1e18) from the configured Broker succeeds. Verified setBroker accepts an arbitrary address; onlyMinter gates mint by caller identity and imposes no collateral/deposit check or economic ceiling. The 172800-second Timelock delay does not make arbitrary minter authorization economically bounded. D29 screening confirms MentoGovernor proposer/canceller membership, open execution, Timelock administration, and no such Safe roles; the separately observed canceller 0xe6951c4176aab41097c6f5fe11e9c515b7108acd is not asserted to have mint power. The governor uses the verified lock-escrowed veMENTO contract. However validators() on this token resolves to 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, whose proxy owner is separate Celo Governance 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972: independently replacing this token-authorized implementation is not rooted in MentoGovernor. Current Validators targets registry USDm, not this token; that observation does not close its independent upgrade path. Complete governor-only issuance closure is therefore not certified and no governedIssuance or complete executionScope is authored. This D14 verdict supersedes any earlier raiseable/partially-bounded economic inference; reconciliation and supervision are unchanged.
